status_vocabulary.failed: Task ended without finishing (e.g. max turns).
status_vocabulary.no-change: Task stopped deliberately without changes (work already present).
status_vocabulary.unknown: No local evidence of outcome; never assumed complete.
status_vocabulary.partial: Roadmap item with some delivered parts and open remainder.
